title: Code review: fix scan_vault glob vs rglob semantics
description: Staff review 🟡 Should-fix #6. chunker.py:14-16 always uses rglob regardless of whether the include pattern contains **. User sets include = ['*.md'] meaning 'top-level only' but silently gets every markdown file at every depth. Fix: use Path.glob for patterns without '**', Path.rglob for patterns with '**'. Add a test with both a top-level-only pattern and a recursive pattern to lock behavior in.
close_reason: scan_vault now uses Path.glob() directly (no removeprefix hack); non-recursive patterns stay top-level, recursive patterns with ** traverse. 2 regression tests lock in the semantics. 28 tests pass, ruff clean.

WAL files can grow unboundedly. close_reason: Store.__enter__/__exit__ added; tests/conftest.py provides store fixture; all 5 Store tests converted to use fixture. Pure structural change, 18 tests still pass, ruff clean.

title: Code review: fix upsert_file delete order and document rowid invariant
description: Staff review 🔴 Must-fix #2. upsert_file (store.py:76-82) relies on implicit chunks.id == vec_chunks.rowid correspondence, undocumented. Delete order: SELECT ids → DELETE vec_chunks by rowid → DELETE chunks. If anyone ever inserts into one table without the other, search silently drops rows. Fix: delete from chunks first (authoritative), then vec_chunks; add module docstring documenting the rowid-correspondence invariant; add a private helper or assertion that enforces paired inserts via _insert_pair only.
close_reason: upsert_file deletes chunks before vec_chunks; module docstring documents the chunks.id=vec_chunks.rowid invariant; regression test locks in the behavior. 19 tests pass, ruff clean.

title: Code review: parameterize Store embedding dimension and validate length
description: Staff review 🟡 Should-fix #3. Store hardcodes float[384] in DDL (store.py:20) and never validates embedding length. Wrong-dim vector produces cryptic sqlite-vec C-extension error instead of clear Python error. Accept dim: int = 384 in Store.__init__, use in DDL, validate in _insert_pair and knn_search (assert len(embedding) == self._dim). Prevents a class of silent corruption that would surface as mysterious search-quality degradation after Phase 3.
close_reason: Store.__init__ accepts dim parameter (default 384); _check_dim validates embedding length at insert and knn_search boundaries; 3 new regression tests for wrong-dim rejection and custom dim round-trip. 22 tests pass, ruff clean.
